incompatibleRuntime.title: This system is not supported by the bundled backend
incompatibleRuntime.description: One Work opened, but the local One Work Core backend cannot run on this Linux version. Please upgrade to a supported Linux distribution and restart One Work.

incompleteInstallation.title: One Work installation is incomplete
incompleteInstallation.description: This installation is missing required local resources, so One Work Core cannot start. Please download and reinstall the latest One Work. If the issue returns after reinstalling, check whether security or antivirus software quarantined One Work Core.
incompleteInstallation.runtimeComponentDescription: {{resource}} cannot start: this installation is missing the bundled runtime component it needs. Everything else still works — you can switch to another model or backend and keep going. Either the installer did not include the component, or security software quarantined it; sending a diagnostic report tells us which.

packageArchitectureMismatch.title: One Work package architecture mismatch
packageArchitectureMismatch.description: This One Work package is for {{packageArch}}, but this Mac is {{deviceArch}}. You may have downloaded the wrong package. Please download and install the {{expectedArch}} package.

dataMigration.title: Local data migration failed
dataMigration.description: One Work opened, but One Work Core stopped while initializing local data. Reinstalling One Work may not fix this. Send a diagnostics report or contact support so the local database migration can be inspected.

databaseNewerThanApp.title: A newer version of One Work is required
databaseNewerThanApp.description: Your local data was created by a newer version of One Work, and this version can't open it. Update One Work to the latest version to continue — your data is intact, and no reinstall or data reset is needed.
databaseNewerThanApp.descriptionWithVersion: Your local data was created by a version of One Work newer than the one installed now (v{{currentVersion}}), so this version can't open it. Update One Work to the latest version to continue — your data is intact, and no reinstall or data reset is needed.

localDataRepair.title: Local data repair failed
localDataRepair.description: One Work opened, but One Work Core stopped while repairing local agent cache data. Reinstalling One Work may not fix this. Send a diagnostics report or contact support so the local database can be inspected.

startupDirectory.title: Startup directory is unavailable
startupDirectory.description: One Work opened, but One Work Core could not start because the configured work or log directory is missing, unavailable, or blocked by permissions. Check that the configured directories exist and are writable, then restart One Work.

recoverableDatabaseCorruption.title: Local data is corrupted
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.description: One Work detected that the local database is corrupted and cannot continue startup. After confirmation, One Work will back up the old database and create a new local database to continue startup. Historical local data will not be shown for now, and the old database will be kept as a backup.
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.confirmRebuild: Back up old DB and rebuild new DB
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.diagnosticsHint: Sending diagnostics will not modify the local database.
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.rebuildFailed: Failed to back up old DB and rebuild new DB

confirmDialog.title: Rebuild the database?
confirmDialog.content: This will back up the currently corrupted database and create a brand-new empty one. Past conversations will no longer be shown (the old database is kept as a backup file). Continue?

transientConcurrentStartup.title: One Work is starting up
transientConcurrentStartup.description: Another One Work startup was still using the local data when this window opened. This is temporary and your data is safe — no reinstall is needed. Please wait a moment and try again, or restart One Work.
transientConcurrentStartup.diagnosticsHint: If this keeps happening, you can send a diagnostics report.

pendingSlow.title: Starting up
pendingSlow.description: One Work is starting up, please wait. If it doesn't respond after a while, you can quit and reopen the app.

exited.title: Startup didn't complete
exited.description: One Work couldn't finish starting and has exited. Please restart the app; if this keeps happening, please send diagnostics.
exited.diagnosticsReportFailed: Failed to send diagnostics, please retry

portReportTimeout.title: Startup timed out
portReportTimeout.description: One Work didn't finish starting within the expected time. Please restart the app; if this keeps happening, please send diagnostics.
portReportTimeout.diagnosticsReportFailed: Failed to send diagnostics, please retry

startupFailed.title: Startup failed
startupFailed.description: One Work failed to start. Please restart the app; if this keeps happening, please send diagnostics.
startupFailed.diagnosticsReportFailed: Failed to send diagnostics, please retry

enterprise.title: Project Group
enterprise.roleUpdateLastAdmin: This person is the only administrator. Promote another member to admin before demoting them.
enterprise.joinAlready: You are already a member of this project group
enterprise.tenantNameRequired: Please enter a project group name
enterprise.exitLastAdmin: You are the only administrator. Promote at least one member to admin before you leave.
enterprise.contextError: Failed to load project group info
enterprise.identityEmpty: Not signed in via enterprise SSO yet — no enterprise identity to show.
enterprise.orgIdentityHint: From your SSO login — independent of the project group.
enterprise.exitHint: You will return to personal mode. If the admin set an exit password, enter it below:
enterprise.joinHint: Enter the invite code from your admin to join.
enterprise.joinModeHint: This machine is in client mode. To host a project group here, go to Settings → Remote Connection and switch to server.
enterprise.joinHintClient: Already connected to a remote server? Your admin's invite code works in the box below.
enterprise.createHint: This machine will become the project group server and you will become the system admin.
enterprise.staleDataDetected: Stale project group data was found on this machine. It must be archived and cleared before a new project group can be created.
enterprise.resetLocalConfirmDesc: This machine still has old project group data. It will be archived to a local file and then cleared; any project group membership previously recorded on this machine will be voided. If this machine is currently serving as a real project group server for others, do not continue.
enterprise.resetLocalSuccess: Local project group data has been reset
enterprise.remoteTitle: Connect to a remote project group server
enterprise.remoteCardHint: You need to connect before you can join a project group on this server with an invite code. SSO sign-in is unaffected by this switch — go to "Enterprise Identity" and sign in directly; a successful login switches this to connected automatically.
enterprise.remoteInviteJoinNeedsConnectHint: Joining a project group with an invite code only (not via SSO) requires turning on the connect switch under "Settings → Remote Connection" first.
enterprise.remoteHint: Once connected, your local conversations/agents/personal data stay local; only project group governance (members/invites/SSO/team resources) comes from the project group server. SSO (Feishu/DingTalk/LDAP, etc.) is completed in the browser.
enterprise.remoteUrlMissing: Set the server address first, under "Deployment mode" on Settings → Remote Connection.
enterprise.remoteUrlFromDeploy: Set it on the Project group page
enterprise.remoteSsoOpened: Authorization page opened in your browser. After login you'll be redirected back automatically.
enterprise.remoteDisableHint: After disconnecting, project group members/invites/team resources will no longer be fetched from the server; your local personal data is unaffected. Remote login state is preserved — no need to log in again next time.
enterprise.remoteUrlRequired: Please enter a valid server URL (http:// or https://)
enterprise.remoteEnableWarning: Once connected, members, invites, SSO and team resources come from the project group server, while your local conversations, agents and personal data stay local and keep working even if the server is offline. Confirm the other side runs One Work / 1oneCore with the project group module (v2.1.32+) and the address is its WebUI URL.
enterprise.remoteActiveHint: Your local conversations, agents and personal data work as usual; members, invites, SSO and team resources come from the project group server. Turn off the switch on the right to use local data only.
enterprise.remoteEnterpriseNoModule: The remote server doesn't expose the project group API (/api/one/*). Make sure it's running One Work with the project group module, not an older version or a static WebUI only.
enterprise.remoteEnterpriseUnreachable: Can't reach the remote server. Check the address, port, and firewall, then retry.
enterprise.remoteAdminUrlHint: Admin console shares the API URL. Open in browser: {{url}}
enterprise.adminConsoleHint: Open this URL in a browser to manage invites, members, SSO, and more (admin WebUI login required):
enterprise.loginBrowserHint: Feishu, DingTalk, and WeCom open in your system browser. LDAP and local accounts sign in on the WebUI login page. Return here and join your project group on the Project Group page.
enterprise.loginBrowserOpened: Login page opened in your browser. Return here after authorization.
enterprise.loginBrowserOpenedPassword: Login page opened in your browser. Sign in with {{method}}.
enterprise.loginWebuiRequired: Could not open the browser login page. Start WebUI first under Settings → Remote connection.
enterprise.loginChannelUnavailable: {{method}} login is not enabled for your project group. Contact your admin or try another method.
enterprise.remoteBrowserLoginHint: Feishu, DingTalk, LDAP, and other SSO flows complete in the browser, then return to the client.
enterprise.clientCreateHint: Client mode cannot create a project group on this machine. Set the server address under Settings → Remote connection, then use Log in / Join project group.
enterprise.inviteRevokeConfirm: Revoke this invite code? This cannot be undone.
enterprise.runtimeDeleteConfirm: Delete this runtime node? If the machine is still online, it will reappear on its next heartbeat.
enterprise.ssoSecretPlaceholder: Not shown for security; leave blank to keep unchanged
enterprise.ssoRedirectUriHint: The callback path is fixed at /api/one/sso/{{provider}}/callback (not /api/auth/...) — configure the exact same value here and in the OAuth app console.
enterprise.ssoHint: Configure enterprise SSO sign-in (OAuth / LDAP). Once saved, the login page will show the matching SSO entry. Secret fields are never shown back for security — leave blank to keep them unchanged; other fields show the saved value.
enterprise.planGateHint: This feature is not included in the current company plan. Ask a company admin to activate a supporting license key under "Company Console → Subscription & Usage" and try again.
enterprise.orgIdentityCompanyMissing: Company info not available (the login returned no company id)
enterprise.removeEffects: Their sessions end immediately. If this is their last project group under the company, their company seat is released too. This cannot be undone.
enterprise.removeOwnedResources: This member owns {{count}} team resource(s). Hand them over to:
enterprise.transferPlaceholder: Choose a member to receive them
enterprise.transferSkippedWarning: Without a recipient these resources will have no owner able to manage them.
enterprise.removeLastAdmin: This is the only administrator. Promote another member first.
enterprise.backupExportHint: Downloads the enterprise configuration as a single versioned JSON file.
enterprise.backupScopeNote: Includes project groups, members, departments, invites, companies, licence, SSO wiring and shared registries. Excludes conversations, messages and all credentials.
enterprise.backupImportHint: Import a previously exported file. Existing rows with the same key are overwritten.
enterprise.backupImportWarning: This overwrites live configuration for {{tables}} table(s). It cannot be undone.
enterprise.backupParseFailed: That file is not valid JSON.
enterprise.backupNotABundle: That file is not a One Work backup bundle.
enterprise.backupReenterSecrets: Credentials are never included in a backup — re-enter SSO and MCP secrets after restoring.
enterprise.directoryIntro: Sync your org chart and roster from the company IdP (Feishu today), so nobody has to maintain the department tree by hand and departures stop going unnoticed. Synced people do not consume licensed seats — seats count only people who actually signed in.
enterprise.directoryPartial: The sync did not finish, so no departures were derived from it. Reason: {{error}}
enterprise.directoryPartialBanner: The last sync did not finish. The data below may be stale, and no departures were derived from it. Reason: {{error}}
enterprise.directorySkipped: There is no directory to sync on this machine (no Feishu app configured, or no company set up)
enterprise.directoryDepartedHint: These are suggestions. Nothing is processed automatically, and there is deliberately no "process all" — one shaky sync would offboard a crowd. Review each, then click Offboard: if they are in your current project group you get the full flow (hand over resources → remove member → release seat); otherwise only the seat and their access are released, and the hand-over has to be done from their own project group.
enterprise.directoryDepartedEmpty: Nobody has left the directory while keeping an account here
enterprise.companyMemberRemoved: Removed from the company; the seat has been released
enterprise.removeLastCompanyAdmin: This is the company's only administrator. Appoint another company admin first.
enterprise.offboardCompanyOnlyEffects: Releases their licensed seat and immediately invalidates their sessions and company model channel tokens. This cannot be undone.
enterprise.offboardStillInGroups: They are still in these project groups: {{groups}}. Group membership and resource hand-over are not covered here — switch to that group and use its Members page.

enterpriseConsole.title: Project Group Admin Console
enterpriseConsole.adminRequiredHint: The project group admin console requires signing into the WebUI with an administrator account. The current account is not an administrator — switch accounts and try again.
enterpriseConsole.heroHint: Daily chats, tasks and shared workspaces still live in the main workbench — jump back below.
enterpriseConsole.cardIssuesDesc: Requirement sync, task breakdown and cross-role delivery.
enterpriseConsole.cardAgentsDesc: Orchestrate and schedule team digital employees.
enterpriseConsole.cardPipelinesDesc: CI orchestration, runs and quality gates.
enterpriseConsole.cardRagDesc: Fully offline semantic vector knowledge base.
enterpriseConsole.cardCmeasDesc: DORA metrics and delivery performance analysis.
enterpriseConsole.cardCpackDesc: Artifact repo, assets and distribution outlets.
enterpriseConsole.cardCcodeDesc: Code asset ingestion linked to the delivery chain.
enterpriseConsole.cardInvitesDesc: Generate and manage member invite codes.
enterpriseConsole.cardAuditDesc: Member actions and security audit records.
enterpriseConsole.cardSkillsDesc: Team skill assets distributed by the admin to member machines.
enterpriseConsole.cardMcpDesc: Team MCP integration connections distributed by the admin.
enterpriseConsole.cardMemoryDesc: Team memory distributed by the admin (backend in progress).
enterpriseConsole.cardSettingsDesc: Project group name, exit passcode and basics.
enterpriseConsole.cardTeamsDesc: Team structure and org hierarchy management.
enterpriseConsole.cardUsageDesc: Seats, call volume and usage analysis.

superAssistant.agentsEmpty: No digital employees yet — create one to get started.
superAssistant.agentsEmptyHint: Start from a template above, or click "Create Employee".

collaborationContext.issueBinding: Issue "{{subject}}" can use the following enterprise capabilities:
collaborationContext.globalHint: This collaboration flow can use the following enterprise knowledge and tools:

superAssistant.fieldBackendHint: Follows the selected expert by default; you can switch to another installed backend. With no expert, this field decides it.
superAssistant.pickExpertHint: Official assistants and the expert marketplace are both here — click one you have not added and it is added and selected.
superAssistant.fieldInstructionsPlaceholder: System prompt injected on every run (optional)
superAssistant.dispatchStarted: Dispatched to the digital employee, running
superAssistant.issuesEmpty: No issues yet — click "New Issue" to get started
superAssistant.issueDeleteConfirm: Delete this issue and its sub-items?
superAssistant.sharedHint: When enabled, teammates can assign requirements to this digital employee on the collaboration board
superAssistant.settingsScheduleDesc: Schedule format matches upstream One Work-cron: At (absolute timestamp), Every (millisecond interval), Cron (standard cron expression + optional timezone). The scanner checks every 30s.
superAssistant.milestoneDeleteConfirm: Delete this milestone? Linked requirements will be unlinked
superAssistant.pipelineDeleteConfirm: Delete this pipeline and all its run history?
superAssistant.testPlanDeleteConfirm: Delete this test plan and all its test cases?

registries.autoActiveHint: When enabled, member machines' AI assistants load this skill automatically — no manual selection needed.
registries.mcpSecrets: Secrets (JSON: env for stdio, headers for sse)
registries.mcpSecretsHint: e.g. {"Authorization":"Bearer xxx"}. ⚠️ Distributed to every member's machine to support offline use — only put credentials the whole team may share.

rag.configHint: Any OpenAI-compatible /embeddings endpoint (OpenAI / vLLM / Ollama / Zhipu, etc.).
rag.importUrlHint: Supports web pages (auto-converted to plain text) and direct links to PDF / Word / PPT / Excel files, etc.
rag.searchPlaceholderHybrid: Search the knowledge base — meaning or exact terms, error codes, IDs...
rag.agentToolHint: Assistants can now search this knowledge base themselves during a conversation, via the built-in search_team_knowledge tool. Each member only ever retrieves documents they are allowed to see.
rag.similarityTooltip: Semantic similarity. Results are ordered by the fused semantic + keyword rank, so this number may not decrease down the list.

superAssistant.modelRequired: Please select a model for this employee
superAssistant.aionrsProviderRequired: Configure a model provider under Settings → Model first
superAssistant.runErrorProviderNotFound: The model bound to this employee no longer exists — pick a new one under Manage.

company.title: Company Console
company.setupHint: Set up a company for this server. You'll become its administrator and can create and manage multiple project groups.
company.disbandHint: Disbanding the company deletes every project group, membership, and usage record it owns. This cannot be undone.
company.disbandConfirmDesc: This cannot be undone. Type the company name "{{name}}" to confirm:
company.disbandSuccess: Company disbanded ({{groups}} project group(s), {{members}} member(s) removed).
company.leaveLastAdmin: You are the only company administrator. Promote another member to admin before leaving.
company.removeConfirm: Remove {{name}} from the company? Their seat and sessions will be released too.
company.removeLastAdmin: This is the only company administrator. Promote another member to admin before removing them.
company.removeSelf: You can't remove yourself — use "Leave company" instead.
company.groupCreatedHint: Share this invite code so members can join: {{code}}
company.noneHint: No company has been set up on this server. Please ask a system administrator to set one up.
company.clientNotLoggedInHint: This machine is in client mode and has not signed in via enterprise SSO yet, so company information cannot be read right now (this does not mean the server has no company). Please sign in first.
company.notAdminHint: You're a company member but not an administrator, so you can't manage members / project groups / SSO.
company.notMemberHint: This server already hosts the company "{{name}}", but you are not a member. The information above is for reference only — contact a company admin to join.
company.channelIntro: Configure model channels once; members get working models without ever handling an API key.
company.channelUpstreamTip: The vendor or gateway address. Members' requests are forwarded here by the company server.
company.channelKeyTip: Stored on the company server. No endpoint returns it and it never reaches a member's machine.
company.channelKeyKeep: Leave blank to keep the stored key
company.channelKeyRequiredOnCreate: An API key is required when creating a channel
company.channelNameAndUrlRequired: Name and upstream URL are required
company.channelDeleteConfirm: Members lose access to this channel immediately. Delete it?
company.dlpIntro: Rules are evaluated on each member's own machine: a new rule takes a few minutes to start applying, and a hit takes a few minutes to appear here. Recorded excerpts are masked — the matched value itself is never stored.
company.dlpEventsIntro: The 200 most recent. Excerpts are masked — enough to decide whether to follow up, not to reconstruct the text.
company.dlpNoRules: No rules yet. Start in record-only mode and watch the real hit rate before deciding to block anything.
company.dlpPatternTip_keyword: Case-insensitive substring. Enough for a customer name or a project codename.
company.dlpPatternTip_regex: Standard regex. ⚠️ Look-around ((?=, (?!, (?<=, (?<!) is not supported; the pattern is validated when you save.
company.dlpPatternTip_builtin: Built-in patterns include checksum and boundary checks, so they are more accurate than a hand-written regex.
company.dlpActionTip: New rules record only. Blocking before anyone has seen the real hit rate produces false positives, and people who hit those paste into a browser instead — worse than the leak you meant to stop.
company.dlpDeleteConfirm: Deleting stops the rule being distributed immediately. Existing findings are kept. Delete it?
company.dlpNameAndPatternRequired: Name and pattern are both required

billing.licenseExpiredHint: This license has expired. The plan stays downgraded until a new license is activated.
billing.licenseExpiringSoon: Expires in {{days}} day(s). Contact your vendor to renew.
billing.licenseNone: No license activated. Running on the free plan.
billing.licenseHint: A vendor-signed license key is the only way to raise the plan. Administrators only.
billing.upgradeRequiresLicense: Upgrading requires a vendor-issued license key. Please contact your vendor.
billing.downgradeOnlyHint: The plan can only be lowered here. To upgrade, activate a license key above.
billing.allowlistCoversMedia: This one list governs chat and image/video models alike. Once it is filled in, only the models on it may be used — leave an image or video model out and that kind of generation is blocked too.
billing.unpricedMedia: {{count}} image/video generations had no rate and were metered at zero — they consume none of your spend cap, so the cap does not apply to them.
billing.unpricedMediaFix: Enter a unit price for these models under Settings → Models and later generations will count against the cap.
billing.seatPendingWarning: {{count}} people cannot use the product because the seat limit is full — free a seat or upgrade the plan

orgTree.mapHint: Pick a department in the company directory as the root — it and every department under it are mapped into this project group's tree. Safe to re-run: it updates already-mapped departments and removes ones that dropped out of the directory AND are empty locally; manually-created departments are never touched.
orgTree.mapEmpty: No directory data to map yet — sync it first on the Directory page.
orgTree.mapKept: These departments are gone from the directory but were kept because members or sub-departments are still assigned locally: {{names}}
